tooltip.the_long_travail.homecoming.pros: Use Homecoming to unequip The Long Travail.
Life is hard, and the journey harder.
Perhaps it is time to return home,
and prepare a little more before setting out.
tooltip.the_long_travail.renewal.prose.0: Refreshes The Long Travail worn by the user.
tooltip.the_long_travail.renewal.prose.1: If its current reversal conditions feel troublesome, give them a fresh start!
tooltip.the_long_travail.renewal.prose.2: But this also resets all of the user's reversal progress.
tooltip.the_long_travail.wayguide.0: Right-click while wearing The Long Travail to cast it in search of places your journey requires you to visit but you have yet to reach.
tooltip.the_long_travail.wayguide.1: Among those destinations, it prioritizes biomes in the current dimension, then structures.
tooltip.the_long_travail.wayguide.2: No revelation is required. It flies toward a destination if one is found; otherwise, it returns. Search range: up to 5000 blocks.
message.the_long_travail.renewal.success: %s has been refreshed with new reversal conditions.
message.the_long_travail.wayguide.invali: The journey conditions for %s have not been initialized. Check the journey configuration.
message.the_long_travail.wayguide.no_tar: No unvisited destinations remain for %s in this dimension.
message.the_long_travail.wayguide.search: The %s is seeking an unvisited destination...
message.the_long_travail.wayguide.busy: The %s is still searching. Please wait.
message.the_long_travail.wayguide.not_fo: No route was found within the search area. The %s has returned; move to another location and try again.
message.the_long_travail.wayguide.timeou: The search timed out. The %s has returned; move to another location and try again.
message.the_long_travail.wayguide.cancel: Search conditions have changed. The %s has returned; use it again to start a new search.
message.the_long_travail.wayguide.error: The %s cannot guide you right now. Please try again later.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.details.ren: While wearing The Long Travail, hold Renewal and right-click to redraw the Witness requirements for all six themes.
The new requirements may be the same as before and are not guaranteed to be easier. Themes already revealed with Revelation Stones remain revealed and do not need to be revealed again.
Refreshing resets the completed journey records and Witnesses in The Long Travail. The journey must begin anew under the new requirements.
This affects all six themes; a single theme cannot be selected.
Renewal is consumed on successful use. It cannot be used without wearing The Long Travail.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.details.hom: While wearing The Long Travail, hold Homecoming and right-click to remove it.
The removed Long Travail is returned to the user's inventory, or dropped beside the user if there is not enough space.
Its completed journey records and Witnesses are preserved. Equipping it again allows the same journey to continue.
Removing The Long Travail also removes its effects and the additional accessory slots it provides.
Accessories that require The Long Travail, or can no longer remain equipped after those slots are removed, are returned to the inventory. Any that do not fit are dropped nearby.
Homecoming is consumed when The Long Travail is successfully removed.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.details.way: While wearing The Long Travail, hold a Wayguide and right-click to search for journey destinations that remain incomplete.
A Wayguide can find targets even before Revelation Stones have been used.
If any remaining target biomes can occur in the current dimension, those biomes are searched first. If there are no such biome targets, the search instead looks for incomplete structure targets.
During the search, the Wayguide hovers above the user.
If a target is found, it flies a short distance in the target's horizontal direction to show the way. It drops after a short while and can be picked up and used again.
If no target is found, the Wayguide is returned. Move elsewhere and try again.
The search range is at most 5000 blocks and only includes journey destinations in the current dimension.
tooltip.the_long_travail.coloring.0: First of all, this is a brush.
tooltip.the_long_travail.coloring.1: Right-click while holding it to color item names.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.details.col: Right-click while holding Coloring to open its interface. Place an item in the input slot on the left, then choose one of the nine special text styles provided by this mod to color its name.
Once you have chosen a style, take the item from the output slot on the right to apply it. You can also process an entire stack at once.
Coloring only changes how item names are displayed. It does not alter the name text, descriptions, enchantments, attributes, or other item details.
To remove this mod's item name rendering effects, choose Restore Style.
